triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: Webhook event
triggers.help: Creates a job when an event is received from 4me. To set this webhook up, you will need to register the webhook below in 4me under "settings" => "webhooks". Webhook endpoint URL More information on how to use 4me automation rules and webhooks can be found on the 4me developer pages .

input.name: webhook_public_key
input.label: Public PEM key
input.visible_if: input.webhook_policy == "RS256" || input.webhook_policy == "RS384" || input.webhook_policy == "RS512" || input.webhook_policy == "ES256" || input.webhook_policy == "ES256" || input.webhook_policy == "ES384" || input.webhook_policy == "ES512"

input.name: payload_output
input.label: Payload schema
input.hint: The payload schema as defined in the "automation_rule" webhook event.

actions.name: custom_operation
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Use this action to run any 4me GraphQL operation. The ID value in the 4me connector and the GraphQL API is the same as the nodeID value in 4me automation rules or in the 4me REST API.

actions.name: mutation
actions.title: Mutate records
actions.help: Use this action to create, delete or update a record. The ID value in the 4me connector and the GraphQL API is the same as the nodeID value in 4me automation rules or in the 4me REST API.

actions.name: query
actions.title: Query records
actions.help: Use this action to get a single record or search all records that matches your search criteria. The ID value in the 4me connector and the GraphQL API is the same as the nodeID value in 4me automation rules or in the 4me REST API.

actions.name: upload_attachment
actions.title: Upload attachment
actions.description: Upload a file which can be referenced later as an attachment or embedded image in 4me.
actions.help: Upload a file which can be referenced later as an attachment or embedded image, e.g. note attachments, in 4me.
